“Behold, this was the iniquity of your sister Sodom: pride, fullness of bread, and abundance of idleness… neither did she strengthen the hand of the poor and needy. And they were haughty, and committed abomination before Me: therefore, I took them away as I saw fit.” — Ezekiel 16:49-50

When Strangers Come to Town

Picture this: Two strangers walk into a city at twilight. The gates are closing. The streets buzz with wealth, leisure, and the kind of confidence that comes from never knowing hunger or fear. This is Sodom—fat, comfortable, and utterly convinced of its own righteousness.

But something darker lurks beneath the prosperity.

Lot sees them first. His heart pounds. Not because he recognizes them as divine messengers, not yet, but because he knows what happens to strangers in this city after dark. He runs to them, bows low, pleads with them to come under his roof. The urgency in his voice carries the weight of a man who's seen too much.

“Please, my lords, turn aside to your servant's house.”

They initially refuse. They'll stay in the square, they say. But Lot presses them, desperately. Because he knows. In Sodom, the square at night isn't a place for rest. It's a hunting ground.

The meal is barely finished when it begins.

First, a few voices outside. Then more. Then the entire male population of the city—young and old—surrounding the house like a pack of wolves. This isn't some spontaneous mob. This is the whole damn city, mobilized like they've done this dance a thousand times before.

The pounding on the door isn't a polite knock. It's the sound of predators who've caught a scent.

“Where are the men who came to you tonight? Bring them out so that we may know them.”

That word "know" carries the weight of violence. This is the sound of a city that has turned gang rape into public policy, dominance into doctrine. The crowd outside isn't just looking for victims. They're performing a ritual, the systematic humiliation of anyone who dares enter their domain.

But here's what most people miss: they're not just hunting strangers. They're hunting Heaven's messengers. This isn't random criminal behavior. This is coordinated warfare against God Himself.

Lot steps outside, closes the door behind him, and does something that would be unthinkable in any normal society: he offers his own daughters instead. The horror of this moment isn't just in the offer, it's in the fact that Lot, compromised as he is, still understands there are lines even Sodom shouldn't cross. The messengers of Heaven cannot be touched.

But the crowd? They laugh. They mock him. They threaten to do worse to him than to his guests. Because in Sodom, even attempting to protect divine messengers makes you an enemy of the state.

This is the moment the city seals its fate. Not just with individual acts of perversion, but with the collective decision to weaponize depravity against Heaven itself.

The Prosecutor's Case

Centuries later, Ezekiel would lay out the charges like a prosecutor reading an indictment. But this wasn't some religious poetry. This was a forensic breakdown of exactly how a civilization commits suicide:

Pride: They believed their ways were superior to God's ways. Not just different, superior. They looked at Heaven's design and said, "We can do better."

Fullness of bread: They were overfed while others starved. Abundance became their god, and they worshipped it by hoarding it.

Abundance of idleness: They had time to plot evil because they had everything they needed. Comfort bred conspiracy.

They didn't strengthen the hand of the poor: Their prosperity came at the expense of justice. The system was rigged, and they liked it that way.

They were haughty: They mocked righteousness and celebrated rebellion. Sin wasn't something they struggled with, it was something they paraded.

They committed abominations: The Hebrew word to'evah—the same legal term used in Leviticus 18:22. Not the only charge, but absolutely part of the indictment.

This wasn't a city that accidentally fell into sin. This was a civilization that threw a parade for perversion and dared Heaven to respond.

The men surrounding Lot's house weren't just gay, they were predatory. They weren't just sinning, they were weaponizing sin. They weren't just fallen, they had institutionalized the fall and made it the law of the land.

The Spirits That Relocated

Fast-forward to today. Walk through any major city during Pride month. Watch the parades, the celebrations, the corporate sponsorships. Listen to the politicians giving speeches about "progress" and "love." Notice how dissent isn't just discouraged, it's criminalized.

The spirits that ruled Sodom didn't die in the fire. They relocated.

They run school boards now. They program streaming platforms. They design children's cartoons. They occupy government offices. And they use the same playbook: normalize what God calls perversion, criminalize what God calls truth, and demand not just tolerance but total allegiance.

The rainbow flag isn't just a symbol of identity, it's a battle standard. The moment you suggest that maybe, just maybe, there are lines that shouldn't be crossed, the modern Sodomites surround your house. Not with torches and pitchforks, but with cancel culture and lawfare.

They don't just want to live their lives, they want to remake yours. They don't just want acceptance, they want dominion. And anyone who resists gets the Lot treatment: mockery, threats, and promises of worse things to come.

But here's what they've added to the ancient formula: they've industrialized it. Sodom was one city. This is global. Sodom targeted strangers. This targets children. Sodom had to physically surround your house. This has algorithms.

The New Hunting Grounds

The public square isn't just after dark anymore. It's 24/7, and it's digital. The hunting grounds have expanded beyond city limits to encompass every screen, every classroom, every corporate boardroom.

The Educational Complex: They don't wait for strangers to wander into town. They mandate that you send your children to them. And if you resist? They'll take them anyway, through curriculum requirements, mandatory reporting, and "child protection" services that protect everything except actual children.

The Entertainment Machine: Every streaming service, every social media platform, every children's show carefully crafted to normalize the abnormal, celebrate the rebellious, and mock the righteous. It's not accidental, it's coordinated.

The Corporate Cartel: Every June, watch as multinational corporations transform into missionary organizations for sexual revolution. Pride month isn't marketing, it's religious recruitment. And if you don't participate? Your business dies, your career ends, your platform disappears.

The Government Apparatus: Laws that criminalize "hate speech" (biblical truth), mandate "inclusion" (forced participation in rebellion), and protect "vulnerable populations" (aggressive ideological recruitment targets). The badges have changed, but the intimidation tactics remain the same.

The Same Angels, Different Assignment

Here's what keeps the modern Sodomites awake at night: they know the story doesn't end with tolerance. It ends with fire.

Not metaphorical fire. Not symbolic judgment. Real fire that turns cities to ash and leaves nothing but salt and smoke.

The angels who visited Lot weren't there for a cultural exchange. They came to extract the remnant and execute justice. They gave fair warning, they showed mercy to the righteous, and then they did what Heaven does when earthly rebellion reaches critical mass.

They burned it all down.

The same angels are still on assignment. The same God still sits on the throne. The same justice still waits in the wings. And the same choice still stands before every city, every nation, every civilization that thinks it can improve on Heaven's design:

Repent. Get out. Or burn with it.

But this time, they're not just targeting one city. They're surveying continents. The reconnaissance is complete. The target lists are compiled. The extraction protocols are active.

The fire isn't coming, it's authorized and waiting.

Reading the Prophetic Clock

We're not in the early stages of cultural decline. We're in the final warning phase before divine intervention.

“As it was in the days of Lot”: Jesus wasn't making small talk. He was giving you a timeline. And if you have eyes to see, that timeline is now.

The patterns are identical:

  • Institutional protection of predatory behavior
  • Criminalization of moral resistance
  • Systematic targeting of covenant families
  • Weaponization of sexual perversion against Heaven's design
  • Complete societal inversion where good is called evil and evil is called good

But there's something else Jesus said about the days of Lot:

“Even thus shall it be in the day when the Son of man is revealed.”

The fire that consumed Sodom wasn't random judgment. It was surgical precision. And it's about to happen again, on a scale that makes the original look like a practice round.

The Remnant's War Manual

For those who still have eyes to see and ears to hear, the mission is clear:

Stop Apologizing for Truth: Truth never needs a PR team. When Heaven speaks, you don't need focus groups to decide if it's acceptable. The angels didn't poll Sodom before executing judgment.

Identify the System, Not Just the Symptoms: The individual caught in homosexual behavior isn't your enemy. The school board mandating gay pride curriculum is. The corporate executive requiring rainbow flag compliance is. The politician criminalizing biblical truth is. Target the infrastructure, not just the inmates.

Know the Difference Between Struggle and Celebration: There's a difference between someone trapped in sin crying out for help and someone building an altar to rebellion demanding you worship with them. One needs rescue. The other needs resistance.

Withdraw from Babylon's Systems: Stop funding your own destruction. Pull your kids from schools that hate them. Stop shopping with corporations that target them. Stop voting for politicians who criminalize you. Stop attending churches that celebrate what God condemns.

Build Parallel Infrastructure: The remnant doesn't survive by hiding, it survives by creating alternative systems. Alternative education. Alternative economics. Alternative communities. Alternative everything, because Babylon's systems are designed to destroy covenant families.

Prepare for Acceleration: The judgment isn't coming slowly over decades. It's compressed into months and weeks. Economic collapse, social persecution, geographic separation—all of it is moving faster than most people realize.

The Geography of Fire

Sodom wasn't destroyed because it had some gay people. Sodom was destroyed because it had systematically weaponized sexual perversion against Heaven itself, institutionalized predation as civic virtue, and declared war on God's messengers.

Sound familiar?

Walk through San Francisco. Drive through Portland. Spend a week in any major university town. Watch the city council meetings. Read the school board policies. See how they respond when someone quotes Scripture or suggests that maybe children shouldn't be sexualized.

The fire that consumed the original Sodom is about to fall on its modern franchises. Not because they're accidentally sinful, but because they're systematically rebellious.

But here's what most people miss: Lot got out before the fire fell. The righteous weren't destroyed with the wicked. The angels made sure of that.

The same extraction protocols are active today. But you have to be watching for them. You have to be ready to move when they tell you to move. And you have to be willing to leave everything behind when they say it's time.

When the Smoke Clears

The men of Sodom weren't just gay. They were violently godless. The fire wasn't random, it was judicial. The angels didn't come to debate, they came to extract the remnant and execute justice.

And they're coming again.

The smoke is already rising. In major cities. In corporate boardrooms. In government offices. In schools and universities and entertainment complexes. Everywhere the rainbow battle standard flies, the fire is authorized and waiting.

But for the remnant—for those who still know the difference between Heaven's design and Hell's counterfeit—there's a different kind of smoke rising. The smoke of sacrifice. The smoke of covenant. The smoke of prayers ascending before the throne of the One who still judges the earth in righteousness.

The fire that never went out isn't just coming for Babylon's cities.

It's coming to purify the remnant and establish the Kingdom.

The angels know the difference.

Make sure you do too.

“Come out of her, My people, that you be not partakers of her sins, and that you receive not of her plagues.” — Revelation 18:4
